name: free-payment-gateways
description: Self-hosted, zero-monthly-fee payment gateway. Accept bKash/Nagad/Rocket/Bank + Bangla QR (manual verification), bKash Tokenized Checkout, Stripe and demo payments. Works on localhost, any cloud/VPS and as a WordPress/WooCommerce plugin.
author: A.K.M. Tanzir Ahmed (iamtanzir)
